document.title: Finance or Administration Section Chief Complex

positions.title: Finance or Administration Section Chief Complex

tasks.category: Ensure readiness for assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Complete required team management responsibilities.
clarifications: Section recruitment and selection
Standard operating procedures
Team building
Section roster
Necessary equipment

tasks.category: Understand and comply with incident safety procedures and practices.
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure section areas integrate safety considerations into all aspects of section management.

tasks.category: Ensure availability, qualifications, and capabilities of resources to complete
tasks.verbatim_text: Evaluate staffing needs required to manage the section.
clarifications: Organize to meet the needs for management and control of the section.
Make appropriate decisions about immediate needs and actions.
Order additional resources through established channel.
Identify training opportunities.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain briefing from Agency Administrator and/or outgoing Incident Commander.
clarifications: Incident information (e.g., wildland fire decision support documentation; written Delegation of Authority).
Key contact list with phone and fax numbers.
Information gaps to be resolved.
Gather priorities, limitations, fiscal considerations, etc.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain briefing from Incident Commander (one-on-one or in Incident Management Team (IMT) meeting).
clarifications: Incident Commander's priorities, goals, and objectives for IMT and the incident.
Initial instructions concerning the tasks expected of the Finance/Administration Section.
Expected timeframes for briefings, planning meetings, and team meetings.

tasks.category: Gather, update, and apply situational information relevant to the assignment.
tasks.verbatim_text: Collect information from outgoing Finance Section Chief or other personnel responsible for incident prior to arrival.
clarifications: Status of incident and assigned resources.
Status of existing Finance/Administration Section.
Status of agreements (e.g., land use, cost share, blanket purchase, water).
Other information relevant to Finance/Administration Section (e.g., ICP/base/camp locations, medical facilities, road closures).

tasks.category: Model leadership values and principles.
tasks.verbatim_text: Exhibit principles of duty.
clarifications: Be proficient in your job, both technically and as a leader.
Make sound and timely decisions.
Ensure tasks are understood, supervised, and accomplished.
Develop your subordinates for the future.

tasks.category: Model leadership values and principles.
tasks.verbatim_text: Exhibit principles of respect.
clarifications: Know your subordinates and look out for their well-being.
Keep your subordinates informed.
Build the team.
Employ your subordinates in accordance with their capabilities.

tasks.category: Model leadership values and principles.
tasks.verbatim_text: Exhibit principles of integrity.
clarifications: Know yourself and seek improvement.
Seek responsibility and accept responsibility for your actions.
Set the example.

tasks.category: Ensure the safety, welfare, and accountability of assigned personnel.
tasks.verbatim_text: Manage operational periods to achieve objectives.
clarifications: Evaluate need for extended operational periods.
Ensure adequate work/rest ratio.

tasks.category: Establish work assignments and performance expectations, monitor
tasks.verbatim_text: Plan and activate section.
clarifications: Identify units within the section to be activated and order resources required for section operation.
Identify workspace requirements and determine locations.
Brief unit leaders on current and anticipated activity.
Provide initial operating instructions to section personnel.

tasks.category: Establish work assignments and performance expectations, monitor
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure subordinates understand assignment for operational period.

tasks.category: Establish work assignments and performance expectations, monitor
tasks.verbatim_text: Continually evaluate performance.
clarifications: Communicate deficiencies immediately and take corrective action.
Provide training opportunities where available.
Complete personnel performance evaluations according to agency guidelines.

tasks.category: Emphasize teamwork.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish and maintain positive interpersonal and interagency working relationships.

tasks.category: Emphasize teamwork.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish cohesiveness among assigned resources.

tasks.category: Coordinate interdependent activities.
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish priorities and coordinate units within the section.

tasks.category: Coordinate interdependent activities.
tasks.verbatim_text: Interact and coordinate with command staff, general staff, and appropriate unit leaders.
clarifications: Receive and transmit current and accurate information (e.g., claims and potential claims, injury information, work/rest guidelines, pay issues, commissary, procurement, cost).

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Share pertinent Finance/Administration information that may affect the team’s management of the incident.
clarifications: Cost constraints
Land use agreements
Cost share agreements

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Participate in the operational period briefing, emphasizing the needs of the Finance/Administration Section.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure Finance/Administration Section expectations are communicated to other functional areas during meetings and briefings.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide daily briefings to section personnel.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Update Incident Commander as soon as possible on current accomplishments and/or concerns.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide financial summary information on current incident operations to hosting agency representative and command and general staff.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Participate in closeout with agency administrative representative.

tasks.category: Ensure relevant information is exchanged during briefings and debriefings.
tasks.verbatim_text: Participate in agency administrator closeout/after action review (AAR).

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Evaluate and monitor current situation to determine if present plan of action will meet incident objectives.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Assess incident financial complexity. Coordinate strategies to address large-scale or long-term financial issues with Agency Representative(s) and C&G.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Participate in strategic assessment meetings to ensure alignment of host agency values and incident strategies.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Participate in preparation of the Incident Action Plan (IAP) or relevant plan.
clarifications: Advise on current capabilities and limitations.
Determine additional/excess resources.
Discuss long range plans and identify potential or future requirements.

tasks.category: Gather, analyze, and validate information pertinent to the incident or event
tasks.verbatim_text: Assist in development and implementation of Incident Demobilization Plan.
clarifications: Establish lead times.
Consider payment team needs.
Establish commissary cut-off.
Identify high-cost resources.

tasks.category: Make appropriate decisions based on analysis of gathered information.
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure reports and forms are complete, accurate and timely.
clarifications: Review periodically.

tasks.category: Make appropriate decisions based on analysis of gathered information.
tasks.verbatim_text: Coordinate an efficient transfer of position duties when mobilizing/demobilizing.
clarifications: Consider transition early in the incident.
Inform subordinate staff and IC.
Document follow-up actions needed and submit to supervisor.

tasks.category: Make appropriate decisions based on analysis of gathered information.
tasks.verbatim_text: Assemble components of final incident finance package and transfer to responsible agency or person.
